summary: First iteration test of Ansh's Puzzle World. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed against public URL for GET /api/, POST /api/scores (relaxed+timed), GET /api/scores/best (populated and empty combo), GET /api/scores/recent (default + limit), and 422 validation. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): welcome screen title present, play-now-button navigates to setup, all photo testIDs (photo-ansh_1..5, pick-gallery-button), difficulty (grid-3-option, grid-4-option) and mode (mode-relaxed-option, mode-timed-option) options visible; start-puzzle-button navigates to game; puzzle-board renders 8 tiles for 3x3 (empty tile correctly hidden); tapping a tile adjacent to the empty slot increments the moves-counter (verified moves went 0->3); timer-display updates every second in relaxed mode; shuffle-button resets moves to 0; game-back-button returns to setup; 4x4 grid game boots cleanly. No red screens or fatal errors. Minor: 'shadow*' style props deprecation warning from react-native-web appears in console (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web logs deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Coming from src/theme shadow tokens applied via ...shadow.card / ...shadow.soft. Non-blocking on native; consider migrating to boxShadow-compatible tokens for web preview cleanliness. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card, shadow.soft)

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Replace deprecated shadow* style props in theme with boxShadow-compatible values or platform-guard for web to silence RN-web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: POST /api/scores returns 200 (fine), consider 201 for resource creation.

server.py: GET /api/scores/best computes best_moves and best_time_seconds independently across scores (min of each separately) — this is by design per spec but note best_moves and best_time_seconds may come from different plays. Acceptable for this simple app.
PuzzleBoard.tsx: makeShuffled does a random-walk shuffle from solved which guarantees solvability. Good.
game.tsx: saveScore fire-and-forget on win — errors are only console-logged. Acceptable for this app.
seed_data_creation: Test class created a few TEST scores in MongoDB (grid=3 relaxed and grid=4 timed) via POST /api/scores. Not cleaned up — safe as this is a fresh test db and endpoint has no auth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, pytest suite in /app/backend/tests/test_puzzle_api.py covers all endpoints. Frontend testIDs verified: play-now-button, setup-back-button, photo-ansh_1..5, pick-gallery-button, grid-3-option, grid-4-option, mode-relaxed-option, mode-timed-option, start-puzzle-button, puzzle-board, puzzle-tile-<goal>, moves-counter, timer-display, shuffle-button, game-back-button, win-overlay, play-again-button, main-menu-button, lose-overlay, try-again-button, lose-menu-button. Auto-solving the puzzle to reach win-overlay is impractical; solve mechanic + counter + shuffle verified instead per instructions. Gallery pick requires native permission (expo-image-picker) and won't function in web preview — expected.
